shortcuts.title: Relay Texts
shortcuts.detail: Covers muted conversations. Turn its automation on after installing, and keep it on alongside the Notification one.

shortcuts.title: Relay Texts (Notification trigger)
shortcuts.detail: Relays every message that notifies, whatever it says. Keep it on alongside Relay Texts.

shortcuts.title: Send Approved Texts
shortcuts.detail: Sends a text from this phone after you approve it in Approvals. Turn its automation on after installing.
